    gap_width = end_x - start_x

    deck_beams = []
    for i in range(num_panels):
        cx = start_x + (i + 0.5) * panel_width
        b = sandbox.add_beam(x=cx, y=top_y, width=panel_width+0.01, height=deck_height, density=deck_density)
        deck_beams.append(b)
    bottom_beams = []
    for i in range(num_panels):
        cx = start_x + (i + 0.5) * panel_width
        b = sandbox.add_beam(x=cx, y=bottom_y, width=panel_width+0.01, height=0.3, density=truss_density)
        bottom_beams.append(b)
    v_beams = []
    for i in range(num_panels + 1):
        x = start_x + i * panel_width
        b = sandbox.add_beam(x=x, y=(top_y+bottom_y)/2, width=0.3, height=abs(top_y-bottom_y), density=truss_density)
        v_beams.append(b)
    diag_beams = []
    for i in range(num_panels):
        x1, y1 = start_x + i * panel_width, bottom_y
        x2, y2 = start_x + (i+1) * panel_width, top_y
        cx, cy = (x1+x2)/2, (y1+y2)/2
        dist = math.sqrt((x2-x1)**2 + (y2-y1)**2)
        angle = math.atan2(y2-y1, x2-x1)
        b = sandbox.add_beam(x=cx, y=cy, width=dist+0.1, height=0.3, angle=angle, density=truss_density)
        diag_beams.append(b)
    for i in range(num_panels + 1):
        nx = start_x + i * panel_width
        node_pos = (nx, top_y)
        master = v_beams[i]
        if i > 0: sandbox.add_joint(master, deck_beams[i-1], node_pos, type='rigid')
        if i < num_panels: sandbox.add_joint(master, deck_beams[i], node_pos, type='rigid')
        if i > 0: sandbox.add_joint(master, diag_beams[i-1], node_pos, type=joint_type)
    for i in range(num_panels + 1):
        nx = start_x + i * panel_width
        node_pos = (nx, bottom_y)
        master = v_beams[i]
        if i > 0: sandbox.add_joint(master, bottom_beams[i-1], node_pos, type=joint_type)
        if i < num_panels: sandbox.add_joint(master, bottom_beams[i], node_pos, type=joint_type)
        if i < num_panels: sandbox.add_joint(master, diag_beams[i], node_pos, type=joint_type)
    return deck_beams, bottom_beams, v_beams

def build_truss(sandbox, start_x, end_x, deck_density=8.0, truss_density=4.0):
    span = end_x - start_x
    panel_widths = []
    remaining = span
    while remaining > 0:
        if remaining >= 5.0:
            panel_widths.append(5.0)
            remaining -= 5.0
        else:
            panel_widths.append(remaining)
            remaining = 0

    # Precompute cumulative positions for beam connections
    positions = [start_x]
    for width in panel_widths:
        positions.append(positions[-1] + width)

    # Deck beams (top of deck at y = 10.0 => center at 10.0, height 0.3m)
    deck_beams = []
    deck_beam_centers = []
    for i, width in enumerate(panel_widths):
        center_x = positions[i] + width / 2
        b = sandbox.add_beam(
            x=center_x, y=10.0, width=width, height=0.3,
            density=deck_density, friction=0.5
        )
        deck_beams.append(b)
        deck_beam_centers.append(center_x)

    # Connect deck beams with revolute joints to reduce stress
    for i in range(len(deck_beams) - 1):
        anchor_x = positions[i + 1]
        anchor_y = 10.0
        sandbox.add_joint(deck_beams[i], deck_beams[i + 1], (anchor_x, anchor_y), type='pivot')

    # Bottom chord (at y = 7.6, height 0.3m)
    bottom_beams = []
    for i, width in enumerate(panel_widths):
        center_x = positions[i] + width / 2
        b = sandbox.add_beam(
            x=center_x, y=7.6, width=width, height=0.3,
            density=truss_density, friction=0.5
        )
        bottom_beams.append(b)

    # Connect bottom beams with revolute joints
    for i in range(len(bottom_beams) - 1):
        anchor_x = positions[i + 1]
        anchor_y = 7.6
        sandbox.add_joint(bottom_beams[i], bottom_beams[i + 1], (anchor_x, anchor_y), type='pivot')

    # Vertical supports (connect deck to bottom chord)
    vertical_supports = []
    for i in range(len(deck_beams)):
        deck_beam = deck_beams[i]
        deck_beam_center_x = deck_beam_centers[i]
        b = sandbox.add_beam(
            x=deck_beam_center_x, y=(9.85 + 7.75) / 2, width=0.3, height=2.1,  # 0.3m width, 2.1m height
            density=truss_density, friction=0.5
        )
        sandbox.add_joint(b, deck_beam, (deck_beam_center_x, 9.85), type='rigid')  # bottom of deck
        sandbox.add_joint(b, bottom_beams[i], (deck_beam_center_x, 7.75), type='rigid')  # top of bottom chord
        vertical_supports.append(b)

    # Diagonal bracing (Warren truss)
    for i in range(len(panel_widths)):
        # Left to right diagonal (bottom beam left to deck beam right)
        if i < len(panel_widths) - 1:
            bottom_beam = bottom_beams[i]
            start_x_diag = positions[i]
            start_y_diag = 7.75
            deck_beam = deck_beams[i]
            end_x_diag = positions[i] + panel_widths[i]
            end_y_diag = 9.85
            length = math.hypot(end_x_diag - start_x_diag, end_y_diag - start_y_diag)
            angle = math.atan2(end_y_diag - start_y_diag, end_x_diag - start_x_diag)
            center_x_diag = (start_x_diag + end_x_diag) / 2
            center_y_diag = (start_y_diag + end_y_diag) / 2
            b = sandbox.add_beam(
                x=center_x_diag, y=center_y_diag, width=length, height=0.2, angle=angle,
                density=truss_density, friction=0.5
            )
            sandbox.add_joint(b, bottom_beam, (start_x_diag, start_y_diag), type='rigid')
            sandbox.add_joint(b, deck_beam, (end_x_diag, end_y_diag), type='rigid')

        # Right to left diagonal (deck beam right to bottom beam right)
        if i < len(panel_widths) - 1:
            deck_beam = deck_beams[i]
            start_x_diag = positions[i] + panel_widths[i]
            start_y_diag = 9.85
            bottom_beam = bottom_beams[i + 1]
            end_x_diag = positions[i + 1]
            end_y_diag = 7.75
            length = math.hypot(end_x_diag - start_x_diag, end_y_diag - start_y_diag)
            angle = math.atan2(end_y_diag - start_y_diag, end_x_diag - start_x_diag)
            center_x_diag = (start_x_diag + end_x_diag) / 2
            center_y_diag = (start_y_diag + end_y_diag) / 2
            b = sandbox.add_beam(
                x=center_x_diag, y=center_y_diag, width=length, height=0.2, angle=angle,
                density=truss_density, friction=0.5
            )
            sandbox.add_joint(b, deck_beam, (start_x_diag, start_y_diag), type='rigid')
            sandbox.add_joint(b, bottom_beam, (end_x_diag, end_y_diag), type='rigid')

    # Cross-bracing between vertical supports
    for i in range(len(vertical_supports) - 1):
        center_x = (positions[i] + panel_widths[i]/2 + positions[i+1] + panel_widths[i+1]/2) / 2
        b = sandbox.add_beam(
            x=center_x, y=8.5, width=positions[i+1] - positions[i], height=0.3,  # 0.3m height
            density=truss_density, friction=0.5
        )
        sandbox.add_joint(b, vertical_supports[i], (positions[i] + panel_widths[i]/2, 8.5), type='rigid')
        sandbox.add_joint(b, vertical_supports[i+1], (positions[i+1] + panel_widths[i+1]/2, 8.5), type='rigid')

    # Anchors: placed at beam centers to avoid torque
    # Left cliff anchor
    sandbox.add_joint(deck_beams[0], None, (deck_beam_centers[0], 10.0), type='rigid')

    # Right cliff anchors
    sandbox.add_joint(deck_beams[5], None, (deck_beam_centers[5], 10.0), type='rigid')  # 5th panel
    sandbox.add_joint(deck_beams[-1], None, (deck_beam_centers[-1], 10.0), type='rigid')  # last panel

    # Mass Budget Check
    total_mass = sandbox.get_structure_mass()
    if total_mass > 330.0:
        raise ValueError(f"Structure exceeds mass budget: {total_mass} kg > 330 kg")

    return deck_beams[0]

def build_agent(sandbox):
    L_X, R_X = 10.0, 41.0
    deck = build_truss(sandbox, L_X, R_X)
    return deck
